app.name: Quality Board
app.one_liner: A dashboard where operations leads review first-pass quality and log defect causes.
app.audience: Operations leads and reviewers at a delivery team

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Show this week's first-pass quality and the top three defect causes.

screens.name: Defect log
screens.purpose: List defects and let a reviewer record a root cause category for each.

screens.name: Reviewer calibration
screens.purpose: Compare two reviewers' pass or fail verdicts on the same items.

rules: Quality percentage is passed items divided by total items for the selected week.
A defect must have a cause before it can be marked resolved.
Reviewer email addresses are visible only to leads, and a lead can delete a reviewer and all their data on request (privacy).

acceptance.given: a lead is signed in and there are defects this week
acceptance.then: they see the quality percentage and the three most common causes

acceptance.given: a reviewer opens the defects screen
acceptance.when: they save a defect without a cause
acceptance.then: the save is blocked with a clear message

acceptance.given: two reviewers have judged the same items
